text: {"bull":[{"point":"Profitability and cash conversion remain strong, with 5-year operating cash flow at 190% of profit and debt/equity dropping to 0.45.","cite":{"table":"Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 190% of reported profit"}},{"point":"In Q2 FY27, consolidated EBITDA rose 24% YoY to Rs 62,409 crore, driven by a 69% O2C EBITDA surge.","cite":{"quarter":"Q2 FY27","quote":null,"table":null}},{"point":"Jio reached 542 million subscribers with 300 million on 5G, sustaining management visibility of high-teen growth.","cite":{"quarter":"Q2 FY27","quote":null,"table":null}},{"point":"Operating leverage is evident as 3-year profit compounded at 9% annually, outpacing 6% revenue annual growth.","cite":{"table":"Profit compounded at 9% vs revenue at 6%"}}],"bear":[{"point":"Long-term top-line growth is slowing, with revenue compounding at 6% annually over 3 years versus 18% over 5 years.","cite":{"table":"Revenue grew 6% a year over 3 years vs 18% over 5"}},{"point":"Retail margins face ongoing pressure from quick commerce competition, with Q2 FY27 retail EBITDA margin down to 7.8%.","cite":{"quarter":"Q2 FY27","quote":null,"table":null}},{"point":"Telecom ARPU growth remains weak at 1% sequentially in Q3 FY26, highlighting pushback on tariff realization timelines.","cite":{"quarter":"Q3 FY26","quote":null,"table":null}},{"point":"Gigafactory solar and battery capex investments face profitability pushback regarding competitiveness against cheap Chinese imports.","cite":{"quarter":"Q3 FY26","quote":null,"table":null}}],"watch":["Commissioning status of the 20 GW solar module and cell capacity in H1.","Retail EBITDA margin recovery and accretion from quick commerce/online grocery investments.","Final notification and filing timeline for the imminent Jio IPO."]}
